profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Currently working on Gemini in Chrome. https://gemini.google/overview/gemini-in-chrome/?hl=en

Previously worked on content review infrastructure at YouTube and on Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience in Google Cloud (fka Customer Engagement AI / Contact Center AI).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
June 2025 - Present: Gemini in Chrome

October 2023 - June 2025: Supply & Demand Management (SDM), part of YouTube Trust & Safety

August 2021 - October 2023: Agent Assist, part of Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (fka  Customer Engagement AI / Contact Center AI): https://cloud.google.com/products/gemini-enterprise-for-customer-experience

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on telephony software used by our call center agents to service our corporate customers. Wrote new API features for voice biometric services written in Java Spring Boot. Implemented transfer & agent search functionality in softphone widget written in React.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Implemented drag and drop widgets & personalization features for company intranet portal using React.  Designed and built an log tracking development tool using React, Node.js/Express, and MySQL.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Enhanced and designed core features of open courseware web application used to train over two hundred college students in operating heavy machinery. Implemented a user survey system using VueJS and AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, Lambda.

company.name: Segal Design Institute at Northwestern University
